name: bolddesk
description: Create, update and route support tickets, reply to conversations, log work, and search the Knowledge Base in BoldDesk.

BOLDDESK_HOST.title: BoldDesk host
BOLDDESK_HOST.description: Your BoldDesk host name, such as yourcompany.bolddesk.com, or your mapped custom domain. It must match your account, or BoldDesk rejects the request.

BOLDDESK_API_KEY.title: BoldDesk API key (optional)
BOLDDESK_API_KEY.description: Leave empty to sign in with OAuth 2.0 in the browser. To use an API key instead, enter a BoldDesk API key. It acts with the permissions of its user.

endpointCheck.source: vendor docs (developer.bolddesk.com/mcp-server). The endpoint is per account, so it was not called.
